label: Tutorial: Notifications
description: Steps of the Tutorial button on the Notifications page (endpoint notification.page_notifications). A step: target (CSS selector, empty = centred card), title, text (blank line = new paragraph, **bold**, `code`), roles (optional: anonymous, user, member, admin, perm:<key>), demo (rule / bundle: example shown when the target is missing, e.g. an empty list).

steps.title: Everything that happened around you
steps.text: Comments on your rules, votes, edit proposals, new rules from people you follow, alerts that matched, background jobs that finished.

steps.title: Find a notification
steps.text: **Search** the text, pick a **date range**, **group by type** to see one block per kind, or show **only unread** ones.

steps.title: Types
steps.text: Keep only some types: comments, votes, proposals, follows, alerts, jobs, system messages…
